title: Free checks and paper statements for seniors
summary: Explains how to get free checks and paper statements for seniors: customers receive 3 complimentary personal check orders per year (ordered via online banking or support; extra orders use standard rates). Paper statements cost $0.00/month, and stop payments cost $15 per item for outstanding checks with the check number and payee name.
